statement.name: get
statement.sql:
set nocount on;
Declare @FiscalYearStartDate dateTime; Select @FiscalYearStartDate = dbo.ufnWF_GetFiscalYearStartDate(getdate());
declare @T_WorkItems table (
ObjectId uniqueidentifier PRIMARY KEY, ObjectTypeId smallint, id varchar(36),
ObjectId uniqueidentifier , ObjectTypeId smallint, id varchar(36) PRIMARY KEY,
processInstanceID varchar(36), activityInstanceID varchar(36), activityDefinitionID varchar(36), participantID varchar(36), teamId varchar(36), roleid int, state smallint, containerXML varChar(2000), comments varChar(8000), userAction varchar(100), lastUpdateDate varchar(25), createDate datetime
,status varchar(30)
,taskStatusLookupCode smallint ,taskStatusDisplayValue varchar(50)
); Insert into @T_WorkItems
select distinct
pic.object_id, pic.object_type_id,
cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))as id, cast(fwi.process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as processInstanceID, cast(fwi.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as activityInstanceID, cast(lua.activity_definition_id as varchar(36)) as activityDefinitionID, cast(fwi.assignee_id as varchar(36)) as participantID, cast(fwi.team_id as varchar(36)) as teamId, fwi.ROLE_ID as roleid,
case PFPI.CURRENT_STATE_ID when '5' then 5 else fwi.current_state_id end as state,
fwi.current_state_id as state,
fwi.container_xml as containerXML, fwi.comment as comments, fwi.user_action_desc as userAction, cast(fwi.update_datetime as varchar(25)) as lastUpdateDate, fwi.create_datetime as createdDate
,(select case when min(faiAll.activity_desc) is null and ((fpir.process_instance_id is null and fpi.current_state_id in (6, 7, 8)) or (fpir.process_instance_id is not null and fpir.current_state_id in (6, 7, 8))) then 'Closed' when min(faiAll.activity_desc) is null and ((fpir.process_instance_id is null and fpi.current_state_id in (4, 5)) or (fpir.process_instance_id is not null and fpir.current_state_id in (4, 5))) then 'Stand By' else min(faiAll.activity_desc) end from FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpiAll WITH (NOLOCK) left outer join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE faiAll WITH (NOLOCK) on faiAll.process_instance_id = fpiAll.process_instance_id and faiAll.current_state_id = 4 and faiAll.activity_implementation_id in (2, 3) where fpiAll.root_process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id or fpiAll.root_process_instance_id = fpi.root_process_instance_id or fpiAll.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id) status
,isnull(lts.lookupcode,0) taskStatusLookupCode , isnull(lts.displayvalue,'N/A') taskStatusDisplayValue
from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) inner join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai WITH (NOLOCK) on fwi.activity_instance_id = fai.activity_instance_id inner join lu_activity_definition lua WITH (NOLOCK) on lua.activity_definition_id = fai.activity_definition_id
inner join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi WITH (NOLOCK) on fwi.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id inner join LU_PROCESS_DEFINITION lpd WITH (NOLOCK) ON lpd.process_Definition_id = fpi.process_definition_id
inner join PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT pic WITH (NOLOCK) on pic.process_instance_id = IsNull(fpi.root_process_instance_id, fpi.process_instance_id)
inner join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE PFPI WITH (NOLOCK) on PFPI.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id
left outer join gems.dbo.tasks t WITH (NOLOCK) on fwi.WORK_ITEM_ID = t.ClientTaskId left outer join gems.dbo.lookuptaskstatus lts WITH (NOLOCK) on t.taskstatuscode = lts.lookupcode
case when fwi.current_state_id = 4 then '1/1/1900' else @FiscalYearStartDate end
1
(4,5,6)

statement.name: getProcessRelatedObjects
statement.sql:
select cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36)) as workItemId, pic.object_type_id as objectTypeId, pic.object_id as objectId from fact_work_item fwi inner join fact_process_instance fpi on fpi.process_instance_id = fwi.process_instance_id left outer join fact_process_instance fpir on fpi.root_process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id inner join process_instance_context pic on (fpi.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id or fpir.process_instance_id = pic.process_instance_id)
order by fwi.work_item_id, pic.object_type_id

statement.name: getOutgoingTransitions
statement.sql:
select cast(fwiFrom.work_item_id as varchar(36)) as workItemId, cast(ftr.transition_runtime_id as varchar(36)) as transitionId, ftr.transition_desc as description, ftr.transition_type_id as typeId, cast(ftr.from_activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as fromId, cast(ftr.to_activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as toId, ftr.condition as condition from FACT_TRANSITION_RUNTIME ftr inner join FACT_WORK_ITEM fwiFrom on ftr.from_activity_instance_id = fwiFrom.activity_instance_id
order by fwiFrom.work_item_id, ftr.transition_desc

statement.name: getRunningActivities
statement.sql:
select cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36)) as workItemId, cast(fai.activity_instance_id as varchar(36)) as runActivityId, cast(fai.activity_definition_id as varchar(36)) as activityDefinitionID, cast(fai.process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as processInstanceID, fai.current_state_id as state, fai.container_xml as containerXML, fai.client_status_msg as clientStatusMsg, fai.priority as priority, fai.automated_class_name as automatedClass, fai.activity_desc as description, fai.finish_mode_id as finishModeID, fai.activity_implementation_id as implementationID, fai.loop_condition as loopCondition, fai.client_status_msg_xml as clientStatusMsgXml, fai.required_work_item_count as requiredWorkItemCount, fai.start_mode_id as startModeID, cast(fai.sub_process_definition_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessDefID, cast(fai.sub_process_instance_id as varchar(36)) as subProcessInstID, fai.transition_restriction_id as transitionRestrictionID, fai.work_item_limit as workItemLimit, fai.update_datetime as lastUpdateDate, fai.create_datetime as createdDate from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi inner join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi on fwi.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id left outer join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpir on fpi.root_process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id left outer join FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpisub on fpisub.root_process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id or fpisub.root_process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id inner join FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai on fai.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id or fai.process_instance_id = fpir.process_instance_id or fai.process_instance_id = fpisub.process_instance_id
4 (2, 3)
order by fwi.work_item_id, fai.activity_desc

statement.name: getCount
statement.sql: select count(cast(fwi.work_item_id as varchar(36))) as workItemCount from FACT_WORK_ITEM fwi WITH (NOLOCK) inner join fact_activity_instance b WITH (NOLOCK) on fwi.activity_instance_id = b.activity_instance_id and b.current_State_id = 4
